release_scope.rule: On election, persist selected merged SHAs and add scope-specific hard edges before rehearsal; release can precede live product closure with truthful limitations.

declarations: Keep declaration/composite checks; inspect emitted types for private .pnpm paths and retained auth API fields.
packed: Use clean-directory packed consumer tests; see task contract and scripts/release-smoke.mjs.
docs: Verify command/API references against source; validate links and plan DAG; no application tests needed for prose-only edits.
runtime-if-executable-change: pnpm test:runtime if executable rehearsal coverage changes; otherwise verify documented procedures against existing runtime evidence.
browser: Authenticated isolated browser journey; record principal role, candidate SHA and failure outcomes.
live-probes: Run-owned native hosts/accounts only; exact protocol and pinned versions per #283 contract.
live-matrix: Execute every #283/#308 live row; retain failures and missing prerequisites; never substitute fixtures.
evidence-audit: Criterion-to-evidence review with exact SHA/provenance; no secret material or unsupported success claim.
production-authenticated-smoke: Explicit authorization and verified target; existing principal access, authenticated conversation send/read, cursor and immutable identity evidence.

pre-tag-live: Disposable target, DO survival and deployed coordination benchmarks per release skill/Operations.
